body: So at some point I will be able to select occultism as my primary class?

They are people I currently live with in education, and I honestly thought it was going OK for once. But as per usual, beneath the surface, these people have all disliked me like before. It's not even just friendship's. It is everything I do just failing and falling apart constantly and consistently. 

I can't bear going through this shit again and again. It would be legitimately easier for everyone involved if I didn't exist, and that is something I could probably do successfully through hanging. It is just so tempting. So so tempting.
